newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hizbollah wreck militia post,Israeli planes hit back.
newsitem.headline: Hizbollah wreck militia post,Israeli planes hit back.

text.p: Lebanon's Hizbollah guerrillas destroyed a pro-Israeli militia outpost and wounded a militiaman in south Lebanon on Saturday, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
Shortly after the attack, Israeli warplanes rocketed a valley on the southwestern edge of the Bekaa Valley, north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, Lebanese security sources said.

The South Lebanon Army (SLA) militiaman was slightly wounded when guerrillas fired mortar bombs and rockets at his outpost at Ahmadiyyeh, in the eastern sector of the occupation zone, SLA sources said.
"The outpost was destroyed completely. The ammunition stores exploded and the power generators were burnt," a pro-Israeli militia source said.
In Beirut, Hizbollah claimed responsibility for the attack.
Later, two Israeli warplanes fired two rockets into the valley of Litani -- raising the number of air raids into Lebanon to four in two days and to 44 since the beginning of the year.
Simultaneously, Israeli and SLA artillerymen shelled south Lebanon areas facing the outpost. There was no word on casualties in the retaliatory shelling and air strike.

The attack came two days after Hizbollah guerrillas killed three Israeli soldiers and wounded seven in south Lebanon. The pro-Iranian group said on Friday that two of its fighters were killed during the clashes on Thursday night.
Hizbollah is fighting Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine miles) wide occupation zone.
